title: quercus lanata subsp. leiocarpa
intro: Quercus lanata subsp. leiocarpa, commonly known as the Golden White Oak, is a subspecies of deciduous tree native to the mountainous regions of the Mediterranean. The Golden White Oak is valued for its rich source of antioxidants and anti-inflammatory compounds, which have been traditionally used to support respiratory health, reduce fever, and alleviate digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of the Golden White Oak include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which have been shown to possess protective effects against oxidative stress and inflammation.
